race.title: Howard Evans Roofing & Cladding Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: This looks an interesting race but Henry Daly has his string in good order and TRINITY STREET has all the hallmarks of one who will take to fences. She therefore receives the vote in favour of Twistthenightaway and Pottersville . TRINITY STREET (IRE) TWISTTHENIGHTAWAY (IRE) POTTERSVILLE (IRE)
